entities.title: Agent documents
entities.summary: The rules for writing this repository's agent instructions, and the skills that tell an agent how to use the tools.
entities.purpose: Holds directives.md, the rules AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the skills follow (shape, what to include and exclude, skill frontmatter), and skills/, one skill per tool an agent uses.
boundaries: The HASD skills for .dev folders are not here: they are in Meta/Agents/Skills/, copied from human-assisted-software-development.
